title: DCF/Value trading
author: Pigafetta1522
selftext:
Hello, I am writing because I was wondering if anyone else is working on something similar to what I am doing. My main goal is to find actual people to bounce ideas off of, instead of only discussing them with LLMs.

My project is a market screener that goes through all US and EU small caps and runs a DCF analysis on each of them every quarter. The analysis gives me a bear, base and bull value for the stock, along with probabilities for each case. If the expected value is 100% above the current price, the stock is worth investigating further. The screener currently runs on Opus 4.8 high sessions, but I am working on a harness to use local models instead. I only trade value, currently mostly long, though I am also interested in short trading.

Is anyone else working on something similar: mass DCF analysis, or in-depth LLM-based analysis of stocks?

replies.author: Pigafetta1522
replies.body: It isn’t anything you can download, I made it with Claude but it is basically just a table of all stocks that the screener has analysed and the values it assigned to them
